name: io.github.MichaelS1011/ephemora-cell-mcp
title: Ephemora-cell MCP — ephemeral, stateless execution boundary
description: Capability-bound WASM/WASI execution for untrusted agent and MCP workloads: fuel, memory, I/O and time budgets, host-mediated egress under authenticated signed grants, and signed per-execution evidence. No execution state survives into the next run.
